# Autocratico

> Autocratico is a free, open-source (MIT) personal register for Italian bureaucracy: deadlines, payments, checks and cases kept in plain-text files, shown in an installable web app, filed by an always-on agent (headless Claude Code) and announced by a Telegram bot. The interface is in Italian and English.

Site: %SITE_URL%
Source code: %REPO_URL%

## What it does
- Calendar of deadlines by area (home, vehicles, documents, tax), coloured by severity and days left: planned (grey), coming up (amber), urgent (orange), overdue (red), done (green).
- Thresholds: high severity is urgent within 30 days and coming up within 90; medium 14 and 45; low 7 and 21.
- Recurring deadlines (yearly, monthly, every N years), e.g. IMU, TARI, car tax (bollo auto), car inspection, ID card renewal.
- One inbox for everything: Gmail (several accounts), forwarded PEC, photos (HEIC included), PDFs, Telegram messages and voice notes, WhatsApp chat exports, the iOS/macOS share sheet.
- The agent files each item within about a minute: it extracts dates and amounts, updates deadlines.toml, opens or updates a case, and records a git commit that can be undone.
- Flags possible phishing that impersonates public bodies (Agenzia delle Entrate, INPS, municipalities) and never opens links.
- Chat with Claude in the web app, from the ⌘K palette or on Telegram (voice notes too): it answers from the register's files and shows which ones it read. Gmail links pasted in the chat open as previews and are read before the answer.
- Corrections asked in the chat are applied only after the user says yes; each one is a git commit that can be undone from Activity. Reminders can be asked in plain words.
- Live updates: open web apps refresh as soon as the agent or a job changes the register.
- Totals still to pay over the next 3, 6 or 12 months, with estimated amounts marked; expenses, earnings and investments from a separate finance app and broker screenshots.
- Telegram reminders with Done, +1 h and Tomorrow 9:00 buttons; personal data is always redacted in Telegram.
- Privacy mode ("Omissis", key P) hides names, amounts and document numbers for screenshots.
- .ics export for any calendar app.

## What it never does
- It never pays, signs, or writes to public bodies on the user's behalf. It prepares amounts, dates and references; the user acts.

## Data and privacy
- Data lives in a folder of plain-text files (TOML, Markdown, JSON) on the user's computer or home server. No database, no third-party cloud.
- The agent reads document text through the user's own Claude account. Voice notes are transcribed on the user's server.

## Install
git clone %REPO_URL%.git && cd autocratico && ./setup.sh --start
Requirements: Node.js 24, pnpm, Python 3.11; Claude Code for the chat and the agent. Opens on http://127.0.0.1:8790 with a made-up example register.
